name: How long does a custom tile shower installation typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a custom tile shower installation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a custom tile shower installation can vary based on complexity, size, and material choices. Generally, a standard custom tile shower project takes approximately 1 to 3 weeks from start to finish. This timeframe includes demolition (if applicable), preparation of the sub-structure, comprehensive waterproofing, tile setting, grouting, and final sealing. Factors like custom design elements, intricate tile patterns, and the need for structural modifications can extend the timeline. We provide a detailed project schedule after the initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: A custom tile shower installation typically takes 1 to 3 weeks, depending on the project's complexity, size, and specific design elements.
